parsed.answer: The fluid sampled 2013-08-29 09:00 (well F1B, report 2013-08-30) had the higher density, 1.32 g/cm3, versus 1.28 g/cm3 for the fluid sampled 2013-05-28 03:00 (well F11B).
parsed.rationale: Both density values are given directly in the drilling fluid records, and 1.32 g/cm3 exceeds 1.28 g/cm3.
